title: NGS Cleanup Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Confirm cleanup capacity
steps.instruction: Ensure the protocol is configured to perform up to four (4x) cleanups for the Paragon NGS preparation workflow.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package from the provided source and unzip the archive if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware to OT App
steps.instruction: In the OT App, navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload the required .json labware files.

substeps.instruction: Open the OT App and select More → Custom Labware → Add Labware
Choose the appropriate .json files and confirm the upload

steps.title: Upload protocol script to OT App
steps.instruction: In the Protocol tab of the OT App, upload the protocol file that has a .py extension.

substeps.instruction: Click Upload and select the .py file

steps.title: Arrange deck per map
steps.instruction: Set up the deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette using the OT App calibration routine; consult the support articles for detailed guidance.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press the Run button in the OT App to start the NGS cleanup procedure.
